{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Convert batch-B biomarker_final from µg/L to ng/mL (divide by 10)
df_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final'].copy()
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_ngml'] /= 10

# Compute the mean of biomarker_final in ng/mL
mean_biomarker_final_ngml = df_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'].mean()

print(f'Mean week-12 biomarker value (ng/mL) across all patients: {mean_biomarker_final_ngml}')"}
